df-001: SPA posts login credentials to /rest/user/login (HTTP) df-001 authentication: Email and password in request body checked by the login handler; evidence: routes/login.ts:34
df-002: Browser loads Google Fonts stylesheet (HTTPS)
df-003: Chat route calls configured OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint with API key (HTTP) df-003 authentication: LLM_API_KEY supplied to the provider client; evidence: routes/chat.ts:110

df-004: Web3 listeners open WebSocket RPC connections to Alchemy Sepolia and subscribe to contract events (WebSocket) df-004 authentication: ALCHEMY_API_KEY embedded in the RPC URL path; evidence: routes/nftMint.ts:18
df-005: Server fetches a requester-supplied image URL for profile image upload (HTTP)

df-006: Sequelize ORM reads and writes the embedded SQLite database (SQLite) df-006 authentication: Embedded SQLite engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: models/index.ts:34

df-007: OAuth authorization (HTTPS) df-007 authentication: The identity provider authenticates the user at its sign-in endpoint; evidence: frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:31, frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:148
df-008: OAuth profile request (HTTPS) df-008 authentication: The provider checks the OAuth access token sent with the request; evidence: frontend/src/app/Services/user.service.ts:68

df-009: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-009 authentication: no credential check in the resolved handler chain; evidence: routes/checkKeys.ts:34, server.ts:197, server.ts:203, routes/metrics.ts:63, lib/antiCheat.ts:51, server.ts:315, routes/verify.ts:84, lib/insecurity.ts:186

df-010: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-011: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-012: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-010 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:52, routes/dataExport.ts:18, routes/orderHistory.ts:13, lib/insecurity.ts:156 df-010 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-011 authentication: no credential check in the resolved handler chain; evidence: routes/recycles.ts:23, server.ts:197, server.ts:203, routes/metrics.ts:63, lib/antiCheat.ts:51, server.ts:315, routes/verify.ts:84, lib/insecurity.ts:186 df-011 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-012 authentication: token decoded without signature verification; evidence: routes/chat.ts:223 df-012 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a

df-014: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-015: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-014 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:52 df-014 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-015 authentication: no credential check in the resolved handler chain; evidence: routes/login.ts:18, server.ts:197, server.ts:203, routes/metrics.ts:63, lib/antiCheat.ts:51, server.ts:315, routes/verify.ts:84, lib/insecurity.ts:186 df-015 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a

df-017: Direct requests (cookie) (HTTP) df-017 authentication: the handler checks a cookie credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: routes/profileImageFileUpload.ts:35, routes/profileImageUrlUpload.ts:21, routes/userProfile.ts:34, routes/updateUserProfile.ts:17, routes/dataErasure.ts:26, routes/dataErasure.ts:76

trust change within a column (dashed: inferred)
dashed outline = zone, not itself a boundary
solid = direct attack · dashed = via user
STRIDE category: filled = findings in that category
All Critical · High fills to 5 · +N = omitted High categories
counts on a node = threats per severity · ①–⑨ = attack scenario
badges also count scenarios that hit an asset stored there
Dynamic code evaluation = runs runtime data as program code
Most security-critical functions always shown (at most 5), others up
to 3 labels per element: most critical first, then most severe linked
finding; +N = further labels, listed under Further capabilities.
Functions may go undetected: a missing label does not mean absence.
